qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: European scale in steel and materials distribution provides logistics reach, but zero pricing power; operating margins are razor-thin (~2-2.8% EBITDA, ~1% EBIT) and multi-cycle returns on capital fall far short of the 12% ROIC threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (N, REJECT). Spun off from thyssenkrupp in October 2026, tk accelis is a commodity materials distributor and steel service center operating with razor-thin ~2-2.8% adjusted EBITDA margins (~1% EBIT). Lacks structural pricing power as a pure price-taker in cyclical steel and industrial metals, generating sub-hurdle multi-cycle returns on capital well below the 12% ROIC requirement. Downstream gates bypassed per waterfall.
qualitative.evidence: FY2024/25 sales of €11.4B generated an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 2%, rising modestly to 2.8% in the first 9 months of FY25/26 (€256M EBITDA on €9.1B revenue). Structural EBIT margins hover near 1%, and ROCE/ROIC is in the low-to-mid single digits, failing the 12% hurdle. High working capital intensity and commodity inventory price risk prevent sustainable excess economic returns.
